title: Roast Chicken with Creamy Dutch Butter Sauce
description: A classic roast chicken dish with a creamy and delicious Dutch butter sauce.
instructions: Rinse the chicken and pat dry with paper towels.
Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
Place the chicken in a roasting pan and put in the oven.
While the chicken is roasting, melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add the heavy cream to the saucepan and stir until the sauce thickens.
Remove the chicken from the oven and brush the Dutch butter sauce all over it.
Return the chicken to the oven and roast for an additional 15 minutes.
Let the chicken rest for 10 minutes before carving and serving.
